bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, residents face flood fears due to a controversial retaining wall project around the marshland, and the office should investigate who initiated this plan.

Omran Healthcare launched its first manufacturing plant in Gummidipoondi to produce blood pressure monitors, and the district team should support local industrial growth.
Authorities formed seven special teams to apprehend a notorious rowdy gang in Thiruvallur, and the office should track law and order updates closely.
Coastal sand blocked roads in Thiruvallur, causing transit issues, and local officials must ensure immediate clearing of the affected pathways.
Digital Bharat Nidhi, the Tamil Nadu government, and TANFINET signed an agreement to boost broadband access, and the portfolio team should oversee implementation progress.
The IT Ministry unveiled a handbook for secure AI data sharing to boost innovation, and our department should review its adoption across state agencies.
The Tamil Nadu municipal administration launched a WhatsApp and AI-based system for citizens to report garbage and water complaints, and the office should monitor its rollout.
The Tamil Nadu government sanctioned 2200 infrastructure projects focusing on roads and water supply across local bodies, and the office should track project execution.
